D-Tide Alert 1 guide - Week of 16th March

Discord Angbak here for an Alert 1-3 low investments guide.

Mechanics guide can be found below from Rain from discord below:

**Base guidelines**

1. Lvl 40 standard units are used as far as possible
2. Skills are lvl 3 as far as possible (Caecus rouse lvl 6)
3. Soulforge are lvl 1

Take note to ALWAYS GET YOUR SOUL FORGE TO LVL 1 MINIMALLY TO UNLOCK THEIR ARC2 PASSIVE.

As always, please refer to Rain's mechanics guide pinned.

**Wave 1 - you can probably do A2**

![img](s2owtmhw0aqg1)

**Replay**: 8a0cc85c-19e5-31ad-93b0-e5c695f4bfb0#E#a

Key units: Faint

Main wheels: Dusk and Dawn

Main relic: Poison on Rouse

Difficulty: 2/10

Main cheese: Get the free relic (hopefully poison related). Rouse and stall. Rouse applies on poison on boss, rouse all 4 units using DR procs from Dusk and Dawn + any other Skey. Faint is there to get your DR back up, while Leigh is an excellent healer after proccing DR. The other 2 units can just be weakness applies. Chaos kinda helps by giving you more DR, but it is a very simple wave for Alert 1/2

**Wave 2 - toughest wave**

**Replay**: 6440bec7-9f00-310a-852f-324f02932fdf#E#a

Key units: Nymph 

Main wheels: Dmg amp wheels on Nymph (ideally her own wheel)

Main relic: Hunt the whole map to get poison relics

Difficulty: 7/10

Main cheese: The elite is kinda hard. Hunt the whole map to get your poison relics + any surviviabilty relics. For the boss stage, as it gets increasing amount of alerts each time her shield is proc via an attack, the best way to go about it at lower alerts is to stack poison and proc it (Not an attack). Rouse Nymph first, and spam out her exalt as much as possible.

Agrippa's devour is a good source of alert on your team. Pairing it with Ogier's X cost, it should help to stall out more.

Since Nymph exalt is a poison trigger, apply all other sources of poison first before using her exalt. You can also save her exalt for when the fish (?) starts to spawn to one shot them.

This is a very tough wave, don't do anything more than alert 1 if you're new.

**Wave 3 - Easy wave, just scale**

![img](31oat3ni2aqg1)

**Replay**: 4e38700c-093d-3f34-9ee9-48c5e9720ce2#E#a

Key units: Any units that can scale (E.g. Goliath with his rouse, Sanga with her rouse scaling tentacle dmg). 

Main wheels: N.A

Main relic: Guardian Hand, when you have <25% hp, you gain a shield at the start of your turn

Difficulty: 2/10

Main cheese: At alert 1, boss does so little dmg to you that you can just stall with Sanga + Goliath. Sanga rouse gives tentacle dmg so that you can "scale". Just keep playing Beauty marks and let tentacles do damage for you.

Goliath is neat for 2 things:  
1. His rouse lets him scale str and tentacle damage slowly  
2. His Law of the strength allows you to strip enemy boss off their str (from stalling), mitigating some of the dmg taken.

Apart from these 2, just bring weakness. Maintaining your health at <25% allows you to gain a free shield for sustain from the stage relic.

**Wave 4 - BRING CELESTE** 
  
**Replay**: f93d4ba5-dc57-35aa-a27a-7766d78c71f2#E#a

Key units: Winkle (Fragile cleanse + counter bot), Celeste (Removes blighten, CRITICAL), Caecus (Usual solo carry)

Main wheels: Caecus wheel + Land

Main relic: If possible, get any counter/poison relics and rely on it to deal damage.

Difficulty: 3/10

Main cheese: Always rouse Caecus first for the counter gen + sustain. Rouse Winkle next for additional counter gen. Boss has 2 debuffs, fragile and blighten.

Fragile - Reduces shield gain. This can be cleanse via Winkle exalt.  
Blighten - Reduces healing by **66%**, this can be cleansed via Celeste exalt. Always save her exalt to cleanse Blighten in order for Caecus to carry.

Boss has a few multi hits, so just use Caecus 3 cost + Exalt whenever that happens (Increases number of times counter damage is proc-ed). Apart from that, just build up your counter stacks while stalling.

**Wave 5 - Outstat with Mouchette**

**Replay**: 

Key units: Whale Mouchette (you can use mine **101143204** since I have dusk and dawn). Her BIS team as shown above.

Main wheels: Just DR stuff

Main relic: Abuse stage relics to ensure that your units have Aliens to exalt. Play 1 of each card to gain 40 aliens

Difficulty: 1/10, just outstat with Whale Mouchette

<@199210252753698816> <@296679098703544321>  Dunno if anyone else wanted to see the math
Wall of text alert
Ello

Assuming each run of the event gives about 800+400 of each of the event currencies per run (720 base + extra materials + 50% from SR) = 1200 currency per run

Need 14.250 currency to clear shop. 14.250/1.200x120 stamina per run = 1.425 stamina to clear each shop once

Transforming full shop rewards to their basic versions for ease of calculation:
Rose Scrips: 810.000
XP: 16 purple + 80 blue 192 green = 416.000 xp
Edify/skill mats: 3 purple + 8 blue + 50 green = 101 green
Seals: 84

If we did interlude to farm the same amount of mats
XP Interlude: 28.000k xp + 6k rose scrips per run. 416.000 / 28.000 x 20 stamina = 300 stamina for 420.000 xp + 90.000 rose scrips
Edify mats:  30 green + 6.700 rose scrips per run. 101 / 30 x 20 stamina = 70 stamina for 105 green + 23.450 rose scrips
Skill mats: 34 green + 7.200 rose scrips per run. 101 / 34 x 20 stamina = 60 stamina for 102 green + 21.600 rose scrips
Seals: 3 seals + 7.200 rose scrips per run. 81 / 3 x 20 stamina = 540 stamina for 81 seals + 194.400 rose scrips
Rose scrips: 810.000 - 90.000 – 23.450 – 21.600 – 194.400 = 480.550 / 20.000 x 20 stamina = 480 stamina

Stamina cost: 300+70+60+540+480 = 1450 stamina to get the same results in interlude.

Results: Considering just the SR wheel extra rewards (no Vortice nor her SSR wheel), farming the event costs 1.425 stamina, while farming the same materials from interlude (plus a few extra xp, edify and skill mats) costs 1.450 stamina.

Notes: I assumed we always got bonus mats on event (800 per run instead of 720 base). I assumed the worst case for covenant farming. Farming interlude would give 81 new covenants which could be new sets, new mainstats, or even some lucky substat rolls.

TLDR: DON'T farm the event if you don't have Vortice or her wheel, it's not worth it, EXCEPT if you're a brand new player and can't access max level interludes
